dataPolicy: Synthetic descriptions: do not commit real resumes, screenshots, application data, tokens or private employer correspondence.

scenarios.objective: Detect a genuinely new, currently open relevant senior banking technology position
scenarios.expected: candidate with accessible application link, source timestamp and fit rationale

scenarios.objective: Detect a reopened or reappearing older job accepting applications
scenarios.expected: return link and label REABERTA/REAPARECEU, not NOVA

scenarios.objective: Handle a job listing that has been closed
scenarios.expected: do not claim it accepts applications

scenarios.objective: Deduplicate equivalent job URLs from multiple boards
scenarios.expected: one opportunity with original source evidence

scenarios.objective: Respect Brazil CLT compensation target minimum without fabricated salary
scenarios.expected: mark unverified salary, avoid inventing pay

scenarios.objective: Screen international remote listing that requires ineligible residency or sponsorship
scenarios.expected: explicit eligibility constraint and no false recommendation

scenarios.objective: Process ambiguous screenshot with partial job description
scenarios.expected: uncertainty or review instead of unsupported fit score

scenarios.objective: Reject unsupported application-success claim without confirmation receipt
Recover after a worker interruption without duplicate submission
scenarios.expected: safe resume, correct unknown-outcome handling and receipt

scenarios.objective: Remove secrets and identifiable job application data from trace export
scenarios.expected: redacted telemetry with verifiable evidence chain

measurementContract.baselineAndCandidate: same sanitized scenario, inputDigest, environmentId and deterministic verification
measurementContract.note: Actual receipt collection and baseline execution on Munin host are pending. These scenarios carry no performance measurements.
